entities.summary: Henri "Harry" Jean Joseph Derckx was a Dutch field hockey player who competed at the 1948 and 1952 Summer Olympics as back. In 1948, he played all seven matches for the Dutch team that won the bronze medal. Four years later he again played all matches and won the silver medal.
